messages:
sylvia: Heads-up — after the nodepool label rename on gpu-pool, several app-of-apps prune waves are stalling. ArgoCD shows infra-apps stuck in "Pruning" for >10m. Some deletions blocked by finalizers on HelmRelease/drain-job obj

raj: Ack. Which cluster/region?

sylvia: us-west2-prod-gpu. We rolled a terraform change: node_pool.labels key changed from "gpu-node=true" -> "gpu=true". Nodes ended up with mixed labels, daemonset tolerations and node selectors don't match, so drain jobs never schedule, prune waits on pod termination.

kevin: Oof. Can you paste argocd app status and the argocd logs?

sylvia: argocd app get infra-apps shows app-of-apps sync stuck at wave 4/6. Logs: "Prune operation partially failed: resource deletion blocked by finalizer". K8s events: "Pod 0/3 nodes are available: 3 node(s) didn't match node selector."

argocd-bot: deploy failed: app infra-apps: 3 resources failed prune, retrying in 30s :warning:

raj: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) restore the old label alias on nodepool via terraform; 2) manually remove finalizers from the blocking HelmReleases so prune can proceed; 3) scale argocd prune parallelism down to reduce thundering if needed.

kevin: Prefer 1 + 2 short term. Don't brute-delete resources without a ticket. Which HelmReleases are blocking?

sylvia: Found these names: infra-drainjob-1, infra-drainjob-2, infra-drainjob-3. Events show scheduling constraints. Running terraform apply to add the legacy label back now. (terraform run: https://terraform.example/runs/9876)

infra-bot: terraform run 9876: plan approved by raj :white_check_mark:

sylvia: apply finished. Nodes now have both labels (gpu=true and gpu-node=true). Pods still pending for a few because taints/tolerations also mismatched; finalizers still blocking deletes.

raj: Can you show the exact command you used to remove the finalizers so we can script it?

sylvia: Using this one-liner to be safe:
kubectl -n infra get helmrelease -o json \
  | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.finalizers != null) | .metadata.name' \
  | xargs -I{} kubectl -n infra patch helmrelease {} -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":[]}}' --type=merge

kevin: Good. After that, Argocd sync loop finished for infra-apps and prune completed. Capacity returned but we lost 2 GPU nodes during the window (cordon+drain side-effects).

kevin: Creating a follow-up ticket INFRA-789 to track preventing regressions (TF validation, CI checks).

deploy-bot: Created ticket INFRA-789: https://issues.example/INFRA-789 :page_with_curl:

sylvia: Follow-ups I propose: add a TF plan-time validation to detect label key renames, add a k8s node-label consistency check in prow or infra CI, add an alert for "prune pending > 5m", and add a short-lived label-alias reconciliation job to automatically create legacy alias labels for 48h after nodepool updates.

raj: Agreed. I'll own the alert and add a staging test.

kevin: Also suggests adding a pre-deploy GitOps check that simulates prune waves (dry-run) for app-of-apps to catch scheduling/blocker issues before they hit prod.

sylvia: Thanks all :thumbsup: 

kevin: Closing thread, will link INFRA-789 with the terraform module PR and add docs about label aliasing.
